statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). The result r satisfies all of the following: len(r) = N; r[0] = start; for every i with 0 <= i < len(r), 0 <= r[i] < N; for all i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(r), r[i] != r[j]; for every i with 0 <= i < len(r)-1, the n-bit binary representations of r[i] and r[i+1] differ in exactly one bit position; and the n-bit binary representations of r[len(r)-1] and r[0] differ in exactly one bit position. Here two values have n-bit binary representations differing in exactly one bit position when there is exactly one k with 0 <= k < n such that their k-th least significant bits differ.
preconditions: Let N = 2^n, using mathematical exponentiation (under the stated bounds N is at most 65536). The parameter n is an integer with 1 <= n <= 16, and the parameter start is an integer with 0 <= start < N.
